stance_rationale: The HARD_ABORT/admission-ineligible direction is supported, but the Judge draft overstates PIT, hard-gate, Harvey/DSR, lockbox, and AX-008 cleanliness. Revise the verdict artifact so the rejection rests on correctly failed gates rather than narrative acceptance of Forge rebuttals.

scenario_rule_audit.replacement_evidence: This is a Forge-focused real-PIT rework ending in HARD_ABORT with STR_1715 retained, not a replacement admission or sequential admission decision.

statistical_robustness_audit.point_estimate_vs_robust_tradeoff: Raw blend SR 1.6582 and delta_SR +0.0025 are baseline-dominated; true 5-spec Harvey is invalid because FF5/FF6 use zero RMW/CMA placeholders, and linear DSR post-penalty falls to 0.8582.

critical_concerns.description: Judge marks PIT as PASS_WITH_PARTIALS, but run_all.R builds adv20 with frollmean aligned right and selects Date == anchor_d, so same-day volume/close can enter the liquidity filter. Direct rawdata.parquet routing is also accepted as C15-aligned despite the mandate naming load_month_factors().

Hard constraints are failed, not merely disputed: weights.csv has 40 names on 230/267 dates and turnover_summary reports Blend annualized one-way turnover 6.313 > 6.0. Judge acknowledges these but still treats the hard gate as procedurally resolved via multi-sleeve precedent.

Harvey/DSR evidence is internally inconsistent: stage_artifacts harvey_factor_regression_5spec.json still reports 5/5 PASS and log penalty DSR 1.5749, while the narrative claims post-Codex correction to 3 genuine specs and linear DSR 0.8582. Artifact-level evidence does not support Gate 2 PASS.

AX-008 is overclaimed. Forge and Architect reproduce the same flawed artifact set, Codex was REVISE with process-validity objections, WT_005 alpha/risk/optimization packages are absent, and the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_005 directory does not exist.

Lockbox handling is not clean: Forge selects candidates and computes full/OOS metrics through 2026 before Judge, while Judge states lockbox_access_count_non_judge=0 and calls frozen extension moot. This is not a concrete lockbox enforcement record.

Role honesty is weakened by accepting 'Codex REVISE non-blocking' and 'substantive disposition resolves all 8' as sufficient even where primary artifacts remain stale or hard constraints fail. This is close to echo-chamber acceptance of rebuttals.

The Path A retire/L-330 recommendation still overreaches relative to implemented evidence: S3/S4 are proxy ridge models, G1 has sparse positives, and the valid conclusion is rejection of this monthly-feature/simple-scorer implementation, not broad paradigm closure.

alpha_scores.parquet was post-hoc changed to sig_ym x Ticker x score_stage, not the requested Date x Ticker x score_* artifact, and covariance.parquet is only 2x2 sleeve-level PSD rather than a full name-level post-shrink covariance audit.

supporting_arguments: The final admission-ineligible direction is supported by G1 all-direction failure, max blend SR 1.6582 below cutoff, delta_SR +0.0025, bad_improvement negative, and comp sleeve SR near zero.
weights.csv is a true time-series schedule with 267 dates, sum_w=1, max_w=0.05, and no negative weights.
Mailbox covariance.parquet is PSD with eigenvalues approximately 0.0047315 and 0.0035857, condition about 1.32.
The liquidity artifact empirically has adv20 minimum above 2e8, even though the code path uses same-day-aligned adv20.
unresolved_disputes: Whether L-279/AX-007 is an explicit hard-cap amendment for union 40 in this WT, or only a precedent requiring Governor/Q-Lead approval.
Whether post-2023/2024 data use by Forge is authorized lockbox opening or RF-J3 lockbox breach.
Whether narrative corrections inside forge_package can override stale source artifacts such as harvey_factor_regression_5spec.json.
Whether AX-008 can count Architect reproduction as independent when it reproduces numbers but not process-validity defects.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that numeric reproduction by Forge and Architect converts a process-contested artifact set into AX-008 2-of-3 PASS, despite unresolved PIT, hard-constraint, Harvey/DSR, and lockbox defects.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild liquidity filtering with explicit t-1 ADV20 and document C10 compliance from code and artifact.
Either enforce union max_names <= 20 or attach an explicit hard-constraint amendment approving union 40.
Regenerate Harvey/DSR source artifacts with genuine KR FF5/RMW/CMA or mark Gate 2 FAIL.
Separate Pre-LB, Lockbox, and Combined results with a concrete lockbox access log.
Downgrade AX-008 to FAIL or INSUFFICIENT until at least two independent sources validate process correctness, not only metric reproduction.

judge_specific_questions: Replacement 시나리오에서 Sequential Admission 룰 적용 거부 evidence 있는가? NO: this is neither replacement nor sequential admission; it is a hard-abort rework.
baseline의 Harvey gate FAIL 상태가 점 추정 SR 비교 신뢰도 약화시키는가? YES: full 5-spec is invalid and incremental delta_SR is only +0.0025.
AX-001 v2 conditional metric이 defense 가설에 적용됐는가? PARTIAL: bad_improvement is negative, so defense classification is rejected, but Gate 6/tail should be FAIL rather than treated as cleanly resolved.
